title: The Relative Grid: actions on cells of Z^n, information loss and the number of actions
description: A system of actions on finite sets of cells of the lattice Z^n (stretching and compressing part of an object, deleting cells, gluing side neighbours). Studies the information loss of actions in bits and the least number of actions needed to build a shape. Includes the main text (English and Russian), a short paper (English, Russian, Chinese), Lean 4 proofs (42 theorems) and programs.
